body:
I'm not sure I understand what this change is for. If I understood https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14905 correctly, it's about the C# editor tools not finding the path to Rider, but why would the general editor setting contain the correct path if that has to be set manually? Unlike the C# setting which attempts to find the location.

> We already have GodotEditor addon https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/4576, which is good in finding Rider on all OS.

You also own the `JetBrains.Rider.PathLocator` package we use to find Rider for the C# editor setting. Are you saying your addon works but the package doesn't? Can't the package be fixed then?

It just seems weird to sync with the general setting, since the purpose of having different settings is to be able to use different editors for GDScript and C#. It would make more sense to me to fix the locator so it works as users expect, without relying on the general setting being properly configured for Rider.
